forceChildQueryPerObj.description:
Forces individual queries to be executed for every arry/mapp table for every obj returned by the fetch.  This
can be used to circumvent the optimization for using a single query per arry/mapp table for the entire result
when that proves to be slower.

title:
Caller controllable hints to alter the way that queries are generated/executed in a fetch call.  Hints will
NEVER change the returned results.
name: FetchHints
